metadata.question: The Landsat 8 satellite captures pictures of active fire in Monte Pisano, Italy on February 25, 2019, around 10:58 a.m. local time. Was the smoke plume moving in an eastern direction?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Landsat 8 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA or T1_L2) - Date: February 25, 2019 (single day acquisition) - Location: Monte Pisano, Italy (approximately 43.7°N, 10.5°E) - Time: Around 10:58 AM local time 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - we want to see the smoke plume - Need to visualize or analyze the smoke direction - Smoke typically appears in visible bands and can be detected in RGB composites 3. Analyze smoke plume direction # Create sampling points: west and east of the fire center west_point = ee.Geometry.Point([10.48, 43.7]) east_point = ee.Geometry.Point([10.52, 43.7]) # Use aerosol band and visible bands to detect smoke # Smoke shows up in blue band and aerosol optical depth blue = img.select('B2') aerosol = img.select('B1') # Coastal aerosol band # Sample values at different locations center_blue = blue.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=monte_pisano.buffer(500), scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('B2').getInfo() west_blue = blue.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=west_point.buffer(500), scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('B2').getInfo() east_blue = blue.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=east_point.buffer(500), scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('B2').getInfo() print(f"Blue band reflectance - Center: {center_blue:.4f}") print(f"Blue band reflectance - West: {west_blue:.4f}") print(f"Blue band reflectance - East: {east_blue:.4f}") # Check for valid data if center_blue is None or west_blue is None or east_blue is None: print("Cannot extract smoke plume data") print("C3") else: # Smoke causes higher reflectance in blue band # If eastern direction has higher values than western, plume moves east east_enhancement = east_blue - west_blue print(f"East-West difference: {east_enhancement:.4f}") if east_enhancement > 0.01: print("Smoke plume shows eastern movement") print("A") else: print("Smoke plume does not show clear eastern movement") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Monte Pisano, Italy location
monte_pisano = ee.Geometry.Point([10.5, 43.7])
date = '2019-02-25'

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_TOA') \
    .filterDate(date, '2019-02-26') \
    .filterBounds(monte_pisano) \
    .sort('CLOUD_COVER')

size = col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Landsat 8 images found: {size}")

if size == 0:
    print("No Landsat 8 image on Feb 25, 2019")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    img = ee.Image(col.first())
    
    # 3. Analyze smoke plume direction
    # Create sampling points: west and east of the fire center
    west_point = ee.Geometry.Point([10.48, 43.7])
    east_point = ee.Geometry.Point([10.52, 43.7])
    
    # Use aerosol band and visible bands to detect smoke
    # Smoke shows up in blue band and aerosol optical depth
    blue = img.select('B2')
    aerosol = img.select('B1')  # Coastal aerosol band
    
    # Sample values at different locations
    center_blue = blue.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=monte_pisano.buffer(500),
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('B2').getInfo()
    
    west_blue = blue.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=west_point.buffer(500),
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('B2').getInfo()
    
    east_blue = blue.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=east_point.buffer(500),
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('B2').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Blue band reflectance - Center: {center_blue:.4f}")
    print(f"Blue band reflectance - West: {west_blue:.4f}")
    print(f"Blue band reflectance - East: {east_blue:.4f}")
    
    # Check for valid data
    if center_blue is None or west_blue is None or east_blue is None:
        print("Cannot extract smoke plume data")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Smoke causes higher reflectance in blue band
        # If eastern direction has higher values than western, plume moves east
        east_enhancement = east_blue - west_blue
        
        print(f"East-West difference: {east_enhancement:.4f}")
        
        if east_enhancement > 0.01:
            print("Smoke plume shows eastern movement")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Smoke plume does not show clear eastern movement")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
